resources.string: Blocks reels and short videos, and shows a reminder when you reach your daily limit.

Focus Life uses this service to detect short-video screens (YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Facebook Reels, TikTok, Snapchat Spotlight, X videos) and short-video pages in your browser, so it can block them according to your settings. It reads only: which app is open, the IDs of on-screen elements that identify a short-video screen, scroll events, and the address bar of supported browsers. It never reads your messages, passwords or other screen text, stores only counts (videos watched, reels blocked, time spent), and nothing leaves your phone. It only watches those video apps and browsers; it never observes any other app, such as banking or payment apps.
